title: Lipids in circulating tumor cells from colon tumors
summary: Tumours can form secondary tumours (metastases) in other tissues by releasing tumour cells into the bloodstream. This study aims to investigate whether the lipids in these released tumour cells can influence the formation of secondary tumours. To this end, tumour cells will be isolated from 10 ml of blood taken from patients with colon tumours, and the lipidome will then be determined using mass spectrometry. Various enzymes involved in lipid metabolism will then be modified in the laboratory and their effect on the cells investigated.

interventions.name: After obtaining written consent for the study, an additional 10 ml of blood is taken from patients with colon tumours during a routine blood test. Circulating tumour cells (CTCs) are then isolated from this blood sample. The lipidome of these cells is then determined using LC-MS/MS.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
metastatic colon cancer
Exclusion criteria:
Chemotherapy less than 14 days prior to blood sampling
